title: Main weapons
summary: Weapons fire on their own. Merging two equal weapons of the same rarity gives the next rarity (Lv 1 to Lv 4).

sections.title: At a glance
sections.note: Shape is the space the weapon takes in the inventory (■). The tag decides which traits boost it. Range is where it starts shooting.

sections.title: Bowgun
sections.note:
Shoots arrows, dealing damage to enemies.
Pierce Attack · Spread shot · targets Random · range 800
Unlocks on day 17 of the event.
